scientific_integrity: Analytic proof combines graph-automorphism symmetrization, block Laplacian eigendecomposition, the homogeneous optimal base-cost inequality, and a strictly convex scalar expenditure minimization. Reproducible exact symbolic algebra and finite numerical spectrum checks are supplementary; they do not certify all parameter choices. Literature comparison includes full or materially relevant author-accessible texts; specialist prior results may remain undiscovered.
scientific_limitations: Connected finite vertex-transitive core of order at least three, strictly positive automorphism-invariant base edge cost coefficients, common positive private-leaf cost, positive budget, and integer leaf multiplicity are required.
No global uniqueness among asymmetric optimum designs is claimed.
The optimal base gap beta may itself require separate computation; the lifting formula transfers its value exactly.
Continuous-time unnormalized weighted Laplacian objective, not discrete-time stochastic SLEM or normalized Laplacian.
title: A square-root lifting law for optimal diffusion on vertex-transitive pendant networks
